specificity.why: Both give times, transfers, phone numbers and prices. B adds more actionable detail: show dates, cash-only warnings, store-by-store tax-free, ticket-machine queuing and closure dates.

accuracy.why: A routes Sounzan→Owakudani on 19 Dec without noting B's cited 7–24 Dec ropeway suspension. A also calls '01:00 vs 25:00' an hours conflict, though both mean 01:00, and contradicts itself on whether Hana is booked. B is mostly sound, with minor slips: the pirate-ship time, Yuryo slot length, and a 09:00 first ropeway car in winter.

feasibility.why: A sends the group back down the mountain two nights running and depends on 1–2am taxis costing about ¥42k in total. Day 1 has a tight 90-minute check-in before the bus. B keeps the nights local to Sengokuhara/Gora/Miyanoshita and works around the closure. Its Day 3 is ambitious but sequenced well.

fit.why: Both suit 20-somethings with nightlife and group onsen. B's private baths, geisha drinking games, brewpub, beer hall and villa drinks feel more varied and budget-aware. A gets Dotonbori food in on arrival night, which is nice.

sourcing.why: A leans on Xiaohongshu and generic lists, and several items have no source. B cites official notices (the Odakyu closure PDF), official sites and dated reviews.

usefulness.why: B flags critical constraints: the ropeway closure, A Coop's 18:00 close, cash-only lunch, luggage arriving the next day, and the geisha schedule. That makes it more reliable to follow on the ground.

baseline: Pirate ship Togendai→Motohakone stated as ~25 min; the direct crossing is closer to ~40 min
Hakone Ropeway's winter first car is around 09:15, not 09:00
Yuryo private rooms described as 2-hour slots; the standard slot is shorter (~50 min)
Taxi from Tokinosumika to Mishima (30–35 min, two cars) is not budgeted
Motohakone pier→Hakone Shrine walk overstated at ~20 min
variant: Routes Gora–Sounzan–Owakudani ropeway on 19 Dec, ignoring the reported 7–24 Dec 2026 Sounzan–Owakudani suspension
Presents Taruya hours '01:00 on Tabelog vs 25:00' as a conflict, but they are the same time
Geisha Café Bar Hana booking field says 'booked for 8' while the tip says group seating isn't confirmed
Describes Odawara as 'one stop past Hakone-Yumoto', which is only true on the Romancecar
Glass Forest 'lights look better after dark' but the light-up is listed as ending 17:30, leaving a thin dark window
Two late-night return taxis (~¥42k combined) are costly and fragile for the group

judge.summary: B is the stronger guide. It accounts for the reported ropeway closure, keeps evenings near the villa instead of costly late taxi runs, and packs in more distinctive, group-friendly experiences with better sourcing. A is detailed but has a routing problem on Day 1, internal contradictions, and expensive, fragile late-night logistics.

specificity.why: A gives phone numbers and times but leaves the Moto-Hakone stroll vague and admits the Namba night is unresearched. B names specific rooms, slots, dishes, ticket systems, side-path torii shots, coupon apps and a concrete Round1 plan.

accuracy.why: A overstates the Sengokuhara–Yumoto taxi (~45 min/¥8,500) and the Sengokuhara–Togendai bus. It also uses non-winter Gotemba hours and miscasts tax-free as a central counter. B is mostly sound and catches the December outlet hours and store-by-store tax-free, but it understates the pirate ship time and overstates the walk from the pier to the shrine.

feasibility.why: A's Day 2 doubles back to Yumoto, returns to the villa, then sends two taxis back to Yumoto and home again (~¥34k) for one bar. Lunch is at 14:00 after only eggs. B's Day 2 flows logically from Togendai to Gora to Sengokuhara, but Day 1 stacks soba then a buffet two hours apart, and the Tokinosumika-to-Mishima taxi is tight and uncosted.

fit.why: B suits 20-year-olds who want to drink: private mixed onsen, nomihodai, geisha drinking games, a brewpub, a late burger bar, a beer hall under illuminations and Round1. A is more generic and its Osaka night is a placeholder.

sourcing.why: Both cite Google/Tabelog-type sources. B cites official notices, recent reviews and dated posts for most stops and flags unverified items (Round1 hours, geisha show). A has several 'Sources: none' entries plus a self-admitted unresearched stop.

usefulness.why: B's warnings (ropeway section closure, A Coop closing at 18:00, cash-only lunch, TA-Q-BIN timing to Osaka) are actionable. A's biggest cost and time sink is self-inflicted, and its Osaka night offers little guidance.

baseline: Pirate ship Togendai → Motohakone stated as ~25 min; it is closer to 35–40 min.
Walk from Motohakone pier to Hakone Shrine given as ~20 min; it is about 10 min.
Day 1 schedules soba lunch ending 14:05, then an all-you-can-eat buffet at 16:15: back-to-back meals.
Hatsuhana on Saturday lunchtime described as a 'short to moderate' wait, which is optimistic.
Tokinosumika → Mishima taxi (two cars, ~30–35 min) is left uncosted and depends on availability before a timed Hikari.
Refers to 'early December mornings' for Fuji views on a 20 Dec visit.
Tenseien buffet/nomihodai price is left unstated ('priced at booking').
variant: Sengokuhara ↔ Hakone-Yumoto taxi given as ~45 min/¥8,500 per car; realistically ~25–30 min, and the round trip for one bar is a routing blunder.
Day 2 returns to Yumoto for lunch, goes back up to the villa, then taxis back down to Yumoto at night: redundant backtracking.
Sengokuhara → Togendai bus listed as ~35 min; it is roughly 15–20 min.
Lunch at 14:00 after only black eggs since breakfast is impractical for a group.
Glass Forest described as 'walkable from your villa' yet a taxi is scheduled. MONTA is called 'a short hop' from the villa but needs an 8-min taxi.
Lake Ashi fireworks 'swap in for Glass Forest' tip makes no sense: the fireworks are evening events at Moto-Hakone, not at 16:15 in Sengokuhara.
Gotemba Outlets hours given as 10:00–20:00; December hours are typically 10:00–19:00.
Tax-free described as presenting the passport 'at the counter'; it is handled store by store.
Kodama Mishima → Shin-Osaka stated as ~2h45; Kodama is closer to 3h. The transport block is mislabelled 16:50–17:10.
Moto-Hakone stroll skips Hakone Shrine and the Torii of Peace right beside the pier.

judge.summary: B is the stronger guide. Its Hakone routing is efficient, it is packed with group-appropriate nightlife and onsen experiences, and it gives concrete, well-sourced logistics such as the ropeway closure workaround, A Coop closing time and TA-Q-BIN timing. A is serviceable, but its Day 2 backtracks expensively to Yumoto and its Osaka night is unplanned. B's flaws are smaller: a few timing understatements and an overstuffed Day 1 food schedule.
